schema.data_csv: Each <run_id>_data.csv: columns time, obs_0[, obs_1], x_0, x_1, regime. Rows = num_timesteps + 1.
schema.metadata_json: Each <run_id>_metadata.json: run_id, seed, dynamics_type, observation_type, t_start, t_end, dt, state_dim, obs_dim, observation_noise_std, missing_prob, delay_steps, n_steps, n_times.
schema.metrics_summary_csv: One row per sequence: run_id, seed, dynamics_type, observation_noise_std, delay_steps, missing_prob, obs_dim, state_dim, n_timesteps, rmse_kf, rmse_ekf, rmse_pf, rmse_nn, false_conf_kf, calibration_kf, regime_delay_mean.
